text:
I had the opportunity to use the services at Lucky Tooth Dental Clinic, and I must say I was impressed from the moment I stepped in.
The clinic atmosphere was clean and organized, and the customer service was excellent. The reception staff were polite and provided clear information from start to finish.

The dentist was very kind and explained the treatment process in detail, making me feel relaxed and stress-free.
Importantly, the dentists here are professors from Prince of Songkla University, a renowned medical institution.
This ensures they have extensive knowledge and experience.

Another highlight is that the clinic accepts both Social Security and the 30-Baht Universal Healthcare scheme.
You only need to bring your ID card to receive services without any additional payment (if covered by the scheme). This is very convenient, especially for those looking to save money on oral health care.

In addition, they have a specialist in geriatric dentistry, which is perfect for bringing your parents or elderly family members for treatment, as the dentist truly understands the specific needs of older adults.

Getting there and parking are also not a problem. There is ample and convenient parking, so you don't have to search for a long time.

Overall, I give it a perfect ten out of ten. I'm impressed with the quality of treatment, the cleanliness of the clinic, the service from the staff, and the knowledge and expertise of the dentists.
If you're looking for a good dental clinic with comprehensive services, affordable prices, and convenient access to various insurance plans, I highly recommend Lucky Tooth. You won't be disappointed!
